correctness.rationale: For a uniformly selected fixed-composition two-sample sign word, H_t=bi_t-aj_t and K=max_t|H_t|=abD. Adjacent conditional R-tail comparisons reduce exactly to integer cross products of counts; enumerating all 49 unordered splits at a+b<=14 and all attainable heights exhausts all real thresholds. Independent direct subset enumeration gives no failure through 13 and only (5,9) at 14, with (R=3,K>=36) 4/12 and (R=4,K>=36) 22/64. Independently reconstructing the analytic 3-/4-run word decomposition at b=2a-1 gives four successful three-run words among 3(a-1) and 2(3a-4) successful four-run words among 4(a-1)^2, yielding (a-4)/(6(a-1)^2)>0 for every a>=5. Label reversal and boundary run counts were covered; the finite census is not an inductive infinite proof.
